question: Can a causal post-K2 sweep-and-reclaim entry filter remove early false entries while preserving the original K2 structural stop?

owner_authorization.scope: autonomous 5min/15min research across stop, entry, protection and target families; this stage changes entry rule only
owner_authorization.holdout_policy: one final use only after a candidate clears all pre-holdout gates

window.audit_open_rule: open only for a timeframe whose selected arm passes the development success gate
window.audit_contamination: baseline aggregate outcomes were previously seen; a new entry arm is still frozen before any audit calculation, but claims remain exploratory

signal_frozen.core: K1 directional real body truly crosses SMA(HL2); K2 wick touches it while the full body and close remain on the directional side
signal_frozen.secondary_score: same twelve-component equal-weight causal score as predecessor

factor.name: entry_rule
factor.sweep_reclaim_definition: After K2 and within the clock window, the first completed directional candle must trade strictly beyond the original K2 extreme, then close back on the safe side of both that K2 extreme and its contemporaneous SMA(HL2); enter at the next open.
factor.stop_after_entry: unchanged original K2 extreme; a pre-entry sweep is not a stop because no position exists yet

execution_frozen.entry: factor-defined, always the open after the completed decision candle

selection.method: single registered categorical entry family per timeframe on development only
selection.score: median half-year net bp minus 0.5 times population standard deviation
selection.move_rule: candidate must meet sample eligibility, improve robust score by at least 2bp versus immediate entry, and not reduce worst-fold net bp by more than 3bp
selection.tie_break: higher robust score, higher worst fold, more events, then shorter wait
selection.no_pass: retain immediate entry and record best observed arm separately
selection.development_success_requires: selected mean net bp > 0, robust score > 0, worst fold net bp > -5, and every development fold has positive gross bp
selection.futility: if neither timeframe passes, do not open audit; close this experiment and preregister the next independent entry or protection family
selection.claim_limit: one-dimensional local screen, not a global optimum

matched_control.role: descriptive negative control for every development arm; excluded from selection and all success gates

audit_success_gate.interpretation: exploratory because predecessor aggregate outcomes were already seen

autonomous_next_stage.on_development_failure: carry immediate entry and preregister a post-K2 breakout-confirmation entry family; if that also fails, move to profit-protection timing
autonomous_next_stage.on_audit_failure: diagnose the frozen failure and preregister profit-protection timing
autonomous_next_stage.on_audit_success: freeze candidate and continue to independent protection then target/runner stages before any final holdout
